articles.title: CJP's Das, Ranka try to sneak into Jantar Mantar, detained by Delhi Police
articles.summary: Members of the Cockroach Janta Party gathered at Jantar Mantar carrying the national flag. They aimed to protest against the current government led by Narendramodi.

articles.title: CJI asks petitioners to fix defects after SC flags 14 in INDIA bloc plea against CEC
Activist shot dead while exposing drug trade in Punjab; caught on social media live
articles.summary: Parwinder Singh Jhota was involved in a sting operation targeting a medical store in Mansa. He confronted the store owner about selling prohibited substances and had a heated exchange before being shot.

articles.title: Dad sold apartment, quit job; mom pledged gold: Making of India's latest WGM Sahithi
articles.summary: Sahithi Varshini Moogi’s journey to becoming India’s latest Woman Grandmaster is a story of many elements, with talent, sacrifice, and perseverance only part of it. Despite losing nearly three years to the pandemic and facing financial hardships and limited opportunities, she achieved the milestone with her father, Lokeswara Moogi Rao, as her coach.

articles.title: Michael Dell-backed firm’s $875 million Boca Raton resort bet draws luxury homebuyers; 40% of first 75 condos claimed
articles.summary: An impressive $875 million investment is set to transform The Boca Raton resort into a luxurious haven of residential condominiums. With around 40% of these high-end residences already reserved, pricing starts at $8.95 million and can exceed $20 million.

articles.title: New Yorkers queue for hours to buy subway memorabilia, with signs costing over $1,000
articles.summary: New Yorkers queued for hours at an annual MTA sale in south Brooklyn to buy discarded subway signs, seats and MetroCards. Station signs cost $500 to over $1,000, while orange subway seats sold for around $900.

articles.title: Opal Tower cracks forced Christmas Eve evacuation in 2018; eight years later, it is defect-free
articles.summary: After nearly eight years of uncertainty, Sydney's Opal Tower has officially been declared defect-free, following significant structural issues uncovered in December 2018. This crisis led to evacuations, extensive repairs, and legal conflicts regarding the building's safety standards.

articles.title: 14-year-old Indonesian plants 38,000 mangroves, helps local women turn them into sustainable products
articles.summary: In Indonesia, young activist Harley Fatahillah Yodhaloka Sunoto is leading a passionate campaign for mangrove restoration and climate education. Through his Mangrove Warrior initiative, he has successfully planted thousands of seedlings in critical coastal regions, strengthening ecosystems and supporting local communities.

articles.title: Five Indiana engineering students built a 12-hour wearable that helps visually impaired users detect obstacles beyond a cane or guide dog
articles.summary: Rose-Hulman students have developed a remarkable wearable device tailored for visually impaired individuals. This innovative headgear employs advanced sensors to identify surrounding obstacles, providing users with haptic feedback.

articles.title: Tumbbad 2: Sohum Shah says writing needs time
articles.summary: Sohum Shah says “Tumbbad 2” will surprise audiences. He told Variety India the sequel took five years to write because he wanted it to feel new, not just ride the original’s success.

articles.title: 'Ramayana' makers unveil Jatayu poster featuring Anupam Kher
articles.summary: The character poster for 'Ramayana' introduces Jatayu, a mythical bird that embodies valor and duty. Anupam Kher, a seasoned actor, provides the voice for this pivotal figure.

articles.title: 'Jailer 2' gets devotional touch as Rajinikanth fans offer special prayers
articles.summary: Rajinikanth is set to return to the silver screen with 'Jailer 2', premiering on October 15. With advance ticket sales soaring to Rs 16.56 crore, anticipation is building among fans.

articles.title: ‘Doomsday’ eyes USD 360 million haul in China
articles.summary: Avengers: Doomsday is set to release in December and has reportedly crossed USD 100 million in advance ticket sales. Early projections suggest the film could earn around USD 360 million in China alone.
